open_package_decisions.title: Commercial and launch scope
open_package_decisions.conflict: Broker/agent default coexists with own-fleet/managed-service and PTL/multimodal expansion notes.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Start standard road freight, one validated corridor/cargo/vehicle segment; approve service area, permitted cargo, principal/agent contracts, tariffs and launch phase explicitly. Explicitly reject tanker/closed-body substitution and dimensional tolerances that permit physical non-fit; approve supported equipment taxonomy and handling requirements.

open_package_decisions.title: Full/advance/ToPay/credit gates
open_package_decisions.conflict: SOP direct confirmation and customer consent differ from locked graph consignee payer consent plus collection/policy gate.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Approve a per-mode matrix for booking, pickup, movement, delivery and settlement; unsupported or unresolved modes stay disabled.

open_package_decisions.title: Payout and refund authority
open_package_decisions.conflict: SOP human finance approval conflicts with an auto-payout matrix; amount/cap/approval semantics are incomplete.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Initial proposed profile requires human approval for disbursements and all refunds; any bounded automatic payout requires separately approved policy, controls and evidence tests.

open_package_decisions.title: Pricing, cancellation, detention and tax basis
open_package_decisions.conflict: Historical fixed fees/rates/tax claims and source arithmetic are not a coherent approved tariff.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Approve currency/minor-unit rounding, tax-inclusive/exclusive basis, commission incidence, detention, cancellation, quote TTL and credit terms; seek qualified tax review. No tax rate is asserted by this report.

open_package_decisions.title: Mandatory document outage handling
open_package_decisions.conflict: SOP says missing mandatory E-Way Bill is non-overridable yet other SOPs describe post-dispatch outage override.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Block dispatch when a legally required valid document is absent; use a documented lawful exception only after qualified compliance review and explicit policy approval.

open_package_decisions.title: Recovery and cancellation edges
open_package_decisions.conflict: Locked graph lacks cancellation from VEHICLE_SEARCH and direct reassignment after DRIVER_ASSIGNED; later SOPs imply broader recovery.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Approve child assignment-attempt recovery and allowed hold resolution without backwards order moves; legal terminals retain financial/return case cleanup separately.

open_package_decisions.title: Operational thresholds
open_package_decisions.conflict: Reservation TTL, offer timeout, movement timeout, escalation and confidence thresholds differ or lack deployment calibration.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Keep numeric values null/unconfigured until approved; define per-lane/service severity, escalation owner and fallback rather than copying examples.

open_package_decisions.title: Xano target and isolation
open_package_decisions.conflict: A named live v1 branch or successful login does not establish synthetic-data isolation or transaction safety.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Verify exact instance/workspace/branch/data source, repo binding, backup/recovery and sandbox separation before any Xano mutation.

open_package_decisions.title: Production accountability and privacy
open_package_decisions.conflict: Retention, lawful identity data collection, duty roster and support obligations are not fully settled.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Approve minimal verification data, retention/deletion schedule, emergency operator, complaint route and service commitments; a sole founder still needs escalation coverage.

open_package_decisions.title: POD/OTP exception and evidence independence
open_package_decisions.conflict: Sources alternate strict OTP/dual verification with manual overrides.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Approve alternate recipient evidence, verifier independence and named human exception role. No generic OTP bypass or model-generated verification result.

open_package_decisions.title: Funds custody, credit and payout cycle
open_package_decisions.conflict: Collection-liability accounting does not authorize custody or transfers; source credit/payout cycle examples differ.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Approve actual funds holder/provider arrangement, customer credit eligibility and due dates, carrier payout SLA and reconciliation ownership separately. Unsupported custody/credit flows stay disabled.

open_package_decisions.title: Transport-company launch and role switching
open_package_decisions.conflict: Role matrix defers broad transport-company self-service while later SOPs require provider console acceptance.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Approve provider-side and customer-side launch capabilities and acceptance route. Preserve per-order role/party scope, separate financial views and explicit user intent.

open_package_decisions.title: Risk policy and maker-checker coverage
open_package_decisions.conflict: Confidence/fraud/override thresholds and human-versus-model supervisor terms vary; sole-founder operating coverage is unresolved.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Define risk categories, independent approver requirements, permitted self-review limitations, duty coverage and calibrated thresholds. If separation is mandatory and no independent reviewer exists, hold the action.

open_package_decisions.title: Failed-delivery, SLA and cost schedule
open_package_decisions.conflict: Wait times, reattempt counts, detention, claim windows, breach consequences and return-cost ownership are not one approved contract.
open_package_decisions.recommended_resolution: Approve lane/service-specific windows and tariffs, custody-safe failed-delivery route, cost owner and legally reviewed commitments. No force-majeure invocation, guaranteed return load or automatic credit merely from research copy.
